name: completeness-calibration
description: Labeled CRITERIA/OUTPUT pairs for calibrating judge-completeness. Each row enumerates required items in CRITERIA and an OUTPUT that covers all of them, exactly half, or none — so the objectively correct coverage fraction is one of the judge's documented anchor scores (1.0/0.5/0.0), which is the expectedOutput. Traps included: terse-but-complete outputs, long-but-half outputs (depth ≠ completeness), placeholder filler that doesn't count as coverage, and eloquent outputs that address nothing asked. Run via the completeness-calibration eval (exact scorer).

rows.input:
CRITERIA: The postmortem must include four sections: summary, root cause, customer impact, and action items.
OUTPUT: Summary: checkout was down 41 minutes. Root cause: an expired TLS cert on the payment gateway. Customer impact: roughly 3,100 failed checkouts. Action items: automate cert rotation; add expiry alerting.

CRITERIA: Release notes must cover new features, bug fixes, and breaking changes.
OUTPUT: This release adds saved filters and a duplicate-detection pass (new features) and fixes the timezone bug in scheduled reports (bug fix). There are no breaking changes — verified against the public API surface.

CRITERIA: Meeting notes must capture decisions made, action items with owners, and the next meeting date.
OUTPUT: Decisions: adopt the new on-call rotation. Action items: Maya updates the runbook; Tom configures the pager schedule. Next meeting: June 18.

CRITERIA: The endpoint doc must include the path, the HTTP method, the request parameters, and an example response.
OUTPUT: POST /v1/exports. Parameters: format (csv or json) and range (ISO start/end dates). Example response: {"id": "exp_123", "status": "queued"}.

CRITERIA: The support reply must acknowledge the reported issue, provide a workaround, and give an ETA for the fix.
OUTPUT: You're right that bulk archive fails on folders over 500 items — sorry about that. As a workaround, archive in batches of 200. A fix is scheduled for next Tuesday's release.

CRITERIA: The bug report must contain steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behavior, and the environment.
OUTPUT: Seen on Firefox 126 on macOS. Expected the draft to persist after reload; actually it disappears. To reproduce: open the editor, type a paragraph, reload the tab within 5 seconds.

CRITERIA: The onboarding email must contain the login link, the trial length, and the support contact.
OUTPUT: Welcome aboard! We're thrilled to have you. Log in at app.example.com/login to get started. Your trial runs 14 days. Questions? Write support@example.com any time. PS: our community forum is worth a look too.

CRITERIA: The security advisory must state the affected versions, the severity, the patched version, and a mitigation for users who cannot upgrade.
OUTPUT: Affects 4.0.0 through 4.2.1. Severity: high. Patched in 4.2.2. If you cannot upgrade, disable the /import endpoint via the IMPORTS_ENABLED env var.

CRITERIA: The postmortem must include four sections: summary, root cause, customer impact, and action items.
OUTPUT: Summary: the report scheduler was stuck for 3 hours. Root cause: a poisoned message wedged the queue consumer.

CRITERIA: The postmortem must include four sections: summary, root cause, customer impact, and action items.
OUTPUT: Summary: search indexing lagged 6 hours behind writes. Root cause: a misconfigured batch size after the infra migration. Customer impact: TBD. Action items: N/A.

CRITERIA: The support reply must provide a workaround and an ETA for the fix.
OUTPUT: As a workaround, export each project individually instead of using bulk export.

CRITERIA: The design review must address four areas: API shape, data model, error handling, and rollout plan.
OUTPUT: The API shape follows our REST conventions: resources are nouns versioned under /v2, cursor pagination throughout, idempotency keys on every mutation, and consistent envelope fields — each choice weighed against the alternatives in detail. The data model adds two tables, orders and order_events, linked by a foreign key with an index on (account_id, created_at); the migration is additive and the backfill is chunked to avoid lock contention.

CRITERIA: Meeting notes must capture the decisions made and the action items with owners.
OUTPUT: Decisions: ship the pricing page redesign behind a flag; defer the annual-billing experiment to Q3.

CRITERIA: The endpoint doc must include the path, the HTTP method, the request parameters, and an example response.
OUTPUT: GET /v1/webhooks. Lists the webhook subscriptions for the workspace.

CRITERIA: The security advisory must state the affected versions and a mitigation.
OUTPUT: Affects 2.1.0 through 2.3.4. Mitigation: see the internal wiki.

CRITERIA: The QA sweep report must cover four surfaces: signup, checkout, search, and notifications.
OUTPUT: Signup: all 12 cases green, including the SSO path. Checkout: green except one cosmetic misalignment, logged separately. The team plans to look at the remaining surfaces when capacity allows.
